premise.claim: PR body: "Fixes 14 relative links in docs/ that point at files that don't exist"
premise.reportedComponent: docs/ markdown relative links as rendered by GitHub (target resolves against the containing file's directory in the repo)
premise.patchedComponent: docs/{en,zh} markdown files — exactly the same class; component matches
premise.evidence: scripts/check_links.py on merge-base b8ff60e3 reports 16 broken relative links in docs/; 14 of them are in the 8 files this PR touches (results/base-touched-files-broken.txt), the other 2 are the pre-existing samples/hdfs links the PR intentionally leaves (documented in the PR body).
